content.text: Default should be email. Check register passes provider.
Register doesn't pass provider, so the default in create applies.

candidates.explanation: The provider defaults to AuthProvidersEnum.google when createUserDto.provider is undefined. AuthService.register calls usersService.create without a provider, so email-registered users are stored with provider 'google'. AuthService.validateLogin then rejects them because provider !== email, returning 422 'needLoginViaProvider:google'. The default should be AuthProvidersEnum.email.
register does not set provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email explicitly, so it relies on the faulty default in UsersService.create.

fix.description: Change the default provider in UsersService.create to AuthProvidersEnum.email (and optionally pass provider explicitly in AuthService.register).
